verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect to Stripe through a first-party server. The evidence is only a single probe line: it does not describe which tools are exposed, whether Connect operations (connected accounts, payouts, transfers) are covered, or how authentication and setup work. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage for Connect-specific operations, setup/auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
